title: ConfigErrors
description: Written to standard error, with exit status 2, in JSON mode when the settings files can't be read (COM-121, CONFIG-102) or the workspace can't be loaded (COM-071).

field.description: The setting at fault (backend, or the backend's: linux, workfile, ...), an unknown key, or the resource: config.json (a settings file that isn't a JSON object); where the backend is linux also compat-index, validation.json, dt-schema, tools, deploy.

hint.description: What to do about this error; given for the problems of a settings file (COM-122).

hints.description: What to do about the errors, each once.
